expect_runner: \[motion-plan\] pointer centred in owned foreground game
purpose: PLAN_M5 M5.4 rt_water_shadows (sun) at S8 Water Queens House: geometry and reflections on throughout, compose off (isolates the sun visibility), rt_water_shadows=1 at launch so the water FS are patched with the sun words (40-B records), toggled live. The audited water FS have sun visibility 1 (no cascade), so the temple and columns cast no shadow on the pool in the game; ON removes the FS's own unshadowed sun term D where one traced sun ray is occluded: C' = max(C - (1 - V) D, 0). A 15 s precheck with the key on (its [water] shadows line needs sun records and traced rays, else INVALID), then OFF / ON / OFF with diag-off cost windows and one PNG each, and the shadow view (rt_debug 26: red occluded, green lit, blue unknown). Gates: shot-off-a vs shot-off-b within the OFF repeat noise; shot-on darker than OFF only on water pixels the shadow view marks red (columns/temple shadows on the pool), never brighter; occluded share > 0 and removed % of mean C reported; [water] shadows GPU median against the < 0.05 ms estimate and cost-on minus cost-off against the OFF spread.
